newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel subdued, cargo premiums pressured.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel subdued, cargo premiums pressured.

text.p: NWE jet fuel premiums drifted sideways in quiet business on Friday with cargoes remaining under pressure from slack buying interest, traders said.
Benchmark Jan IPE futures fell $1.75 cents to $216 a tonne in subdued pre-holiday trade amid a dearth of news.
Lack of interest kept pressure on cargoes, which were talked very notionally at Jan IPE +27/28. Barge premiums were Jan IPE +$25/26, supported by modest buying inquiry and scant offers.
Difficulties in fixing vessels plagued efforts to work the arbitrage to Asia and the United States.
